Recognized keys: icon — lucide icon name ("search", "database", "code", …) title — display name shown card header requiresApproval — TRUE show Approve/Deny buttons resultType — render result on_tool_result(): "auto" (default, JSON/text <pre>), "markdown", "table", "code", "image", "file", "html" resultLang — language resultType = "code" (e.g. "r", "python", "sql"; default "text") resultFilename — filename resultType = "file" download button (e.g. "results.csv"; default "download") on_tool_result(tool_call_id, result, is_error = FALSE) — update tool card result. resultType = "table": pass jsonlite::toJSON(df, auto_unbox = FALSE) resultType = "file": pass base64 data URL (paste0("data:text/csv;base64,", jsonlite::base64_enc(chartr(...)))) resultType = "html": pass HTML string (rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; use trusted tool output) attachments — list named lists, one per file user attached. element type ("image", "text", "file"), name (filename), data (data-URL string images, plain text text files, base64 files), optionally contentType (MIME type). Empty list list() attachments present. is_reload — TRUE user clicked "regenerate"; handler receives message text can remove previous assistant turn LLM history re-running. is_cancelled — zero-argument function returns TRUE user clicked stop button.
